episodes.title: Forensic expert analyses photographs of Virginia Giuffre's bruises
episodes.description:
David Wells, an associate professor at Monash University’s department of forensic medicine, analysed photographs of Virginia Giuffre in the days after she alleged Robbie Giuffre assaulted her on a family holiday in 2025. In court documents, Robbie later accused Virginia of violence that night.

Wells says these photographs of Virginia Giuffre tell a story about what happened to her that night.

Listen to Virginia, a four-part podcast hosted and investigated by Walkley-award winning journalist Melissa Fyfe and WA Today reporter Carla Hildebrandt. It chronicles the harrowing final months of Virginia Giuffre's life as her marriage unravelled. Julia Carr-Catzel is the executive producer.

Listen on Apple and Spotify or wherever you get your podcasts.

episodes.title: How we pieced together the final months of Virginia Giuffre’s life
episodes.description:
When Good Weekend senior writer Melissa Fyfe and WAtoday journalist Carla Hildebrandt set out to write about Jeffrey Epstein’s most famous victim, Virginia Giuffre, it began as a piece about the legal battle over her multimillion-dollar estate. But as the reporters started their detailed investigation, a much darker story emerged about the events leading up to her death by suicide in April 2025.

Here, Mel and Carla talk about their compelling Good Weekend cover story and four-part podcast series detailing the anguish Giuffre suffered as she endured domestic violence, a court order denying access to her children, debilitating health issues and the toll of living in the public eye.

episodes.title: Introducing Virginia
episodes.description:
Virginia Giuffre was fearless in taking down some of the world’s most powerful people. As Jeffrey Epstein’s most prominent victim, she helped expose his crimes and hold his friends to account, including the man formerly known as Prince Andrew. But despite her heroic battle in the most notorious sex trafficking case of the 21st century, few know about one of her toughest fights. It was one she fought privately at home in Australia.
Follow The Age and SMH Investigates to be first to listen to new episodes of Virginia from Walkley-award winning journalist Melissa Fyfe and WA Today reporter Carla Hildebrandt.
